business_problem: Members often struggle to understand coverage, costs, and care options, while care teams need better ways to anticipate member needs and help associates answer complex benefit and claim questions quickly and empathetically.
solution_summary: Elevance Health describes a multi-surface AI implementation focused on member navigation, proactive engagement, and associate assistance. In the Sydney Health app, the Virtual Assistant serves as the conversational front end, answering coverage, cost, deductible, and care-location questions for members and returning provider and pricing guidance for specific procedures. It works alongside an AI-driven provider search feature that helps match members to high-quality, lower-cost care. Separately, an AI-driven outreach program analyzes member context and care-gap signals to identify who should receive personalized reminders such as prescription refill prompts or annual wellness outreach. In service operations, a suite of AI tools supports associates with next-best-action suggestions, real-time claim-answering through a conversational chat interface, automated post-call summaries, and sentiment analysis across calls and chats. The source does not name the storage tier or external model providers.

solution_components.name: Sydney Health app
solution_components.role: Digital member channel where Virtual Assistant is launched and where members access AI-enabled support.

solution_components.name: Virtual Assistant
solution_components.role: AI-powered conversational tool that explains coverage, costs, deductible progress, care options, and in-network providers to members.

solution_components.name: provider search feature
solution_components.role: Uses AI-driven personalized matching to help members find high-quality, lower-cost care online and in the app.

solution_components.name: AI-driven outreach program
solution_components.role: Identifies members with care gaps and triggers personalized outreach such as refill reminders and annual wellness prompts.

solution_components.name: program that proactively suggests actions
solution_components.role: Recommends actions to call center associates during live discussions with members.

solution_components.name: conversational chat interface
solution_components.role: Helps associates answer claim-related questions in real time by deriving answers from claim details.

solution_components.name: post-call wrap-up summaries automation
solution_components.role: Automates wrap-up summaries after member interactions.

solution_components.name: sentiment analysis tool
solution_components.role: Processes member calls and chats to analyze sentiment and provide insight into why consumers reach out and how associates respond.

data_flow: Member benefit, deductible, cost, provider-network, and claim-detail data are used by AI services exposed through the Sydney Health app and provider search to answer member questions. A separate outreach program evaluates member health context and care gaps to send personalized text prompts. In the contact center, call and chat interactions plus claim details feed associate tools for action suggestions, real-time answers, automated summaries, and sentiment analysis.
business_outcome: Elevance Health says the implementation makes healthcare journeys simpler and more personalized, gives members faster answers about benefits and care options, enables more proactive outreach, and gives associates more time to focus on empathetic member interactions. Internal research also indicates outreach texting improved participation in annual wellness visits, colorectal cancer screenings, and blood sugar control among identified members.
